items.title: Konitz Lee — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: He was a mean little guy sometimes.

ctx.x: You’ve had two partnerships I just want to talk about briefly. One was you did a number of things with Harold Danko in the eighties: duo things, quartet things. Actually I even remember a gig the two of you were playing in the Village one night that Michel Petrucciani came and was heckling you.
Ooh. Wow, boy. He was a mean little guy sometimes.
